scopeNotes: New text needs independent review; earlier hashes do not certify it.
Map endpoints are not historical founding or extinction dates.

The map snapshots cover 1600 to 1878 north of Alice Springs. Anmatyerre and Anmatyerr are source spellings; the people are not equated with all Utopia residents or neighboring Alyawarr, Warlpiri, Kaytetye and Arrernte peoples.

The community plan was downloaded and its opening historical and planning pages read. It is a 2022 publication for 2021 to 2031; its web page date in 2024 is not the plan’s creation date. Its plans are not all asserted complete.

No restricted location, ritual sequence, site-access information or proprietary cultural detail is reproduced. The card summarizes public historical and program information and links to the community source.

The plan’s compressed timeline contains questionable dates, including Stuart’s journey and the Pine Hill determination. Those dates are not used. The 2018 AIATSIS case record establishes the determination date; the 18 June CLC announcement alone would establish only a planned hearing.
Coniston is included as a historical rupture without reproducing a contested casualty total or implying that all victims belonged to one people.

Gallery transcripts and indexed text were consulted where direct pages returned 403. Recordings themselves were not played. The specific 1981 batik is cotton; other silk batiks are not conflated with it. Dates of acquisition are not production dates.

Kngwarray’s reported birth year varies across older and newer gallery materials and is omitted. Batik and acrylic were new public media within an existing artistic life, not the beginning of art for her or her people.

The dictionary source is a publisher description and bibliographic record, not a complete reading of the book. The 2010 publication and collaborative authorship are supported; no invented translation or linguistic entry is added.

The water planning page establishes the consultation account, not proof of implementation of every management provision or completion of a scheduled review. Groundwater and surface-water interactions are not generalized beyond the evidence.
Native title is explicitly non-exclusive and applies to named landholding groups and a defined claim, not all Anmatyerr Country. No unverified successor link is introduced.
Independent historical review, geometry assessment and depth certification remain pending.
